slides.claim: No full-visual-coverage claim; unknown remains unknown.

worksheet_video.inspection: representative frame extraction plus direct visual inspection

results.killed_claim: Every adapter should look or speak the same to preserve one concept.
results.survivor: Only declared protected semantics and provenance are invariant; presentation may vary by adapter.

results.killed_claim: A plausible deeper need, motive, or causal explanation can be stored as if the user directly said it.
results.survivor: Raw observation, interpretation/hypothesis, and independently validated derived fact must remain separately typed and provenance-bound.

results.killed_claim: A local metric improvement can authorize promotion despite downstream protected-outcome regression.
results.survivor: Local wins cannot override the frozen human-important outcome, but workloads without a downstream surface may mark the profile NOT_APPLICABLE.

results.killed_claim: An aggregate pass implies the effect is acceptable for every material context, or any tiny post-hoc segment may veto the aggregate.
results.survivor: Material evidence-bound contexts/cohorts may block a global diagnosis and force targeted analysis; arbitrary or immaterial post-hoc segmentation cannot.

results.killed_claim: A downstream artifact remains current merely because it still exists or previously passed review after an upstream decision changed.
results.survivor: A derived artifact is revision-bound to the upstream fields it consumed. A material dependency change makes it stale until recomputed from the current revision or boundedly revalidated; unrelated upstream changes do not force global rebuild.

results.killed_claim: A control or workflow policy selected for one maturity/risk/operating context can silently become universal or remain valid after the selecting context changes.
results.survivor: Policy applicability remains context-bound. Material context changes require policy re-evaluation, but this composes as a profile/selection refinement rather than a new universal subsystem.

results.killed_claim: A broad success statement may erase a concrete failure, or narrow evidence may establish a broader property without validated coverage.
results.survivor: Evidence and claims remain scope-bound. Cross-level claims require an explicit validated scope bridge. This is retained as a refinement of construct-validity/context guards rather than a separate canonical subsystem.

death_memory: ABSTRACT SUCCESS != REFUTATION OF CONCRETE FAILURE
NARROW EVIDENCE != BROADER CLAIM WITHOUT SCOPE BRIDGE

repository_validation.scope_note: This run validates contract logic and regression behavior only; it is not real-world same-workload proof.

next_gate: Use real same-workload attacks before any canonical patch: mutate upstream decisions after downstream artifacts were generated and verify selective stale propagation; change material operating context and verify policy reselection without universalizing profiles; attempt abstraction escape across component/subsystem/system evidence. Continue attacks on observation/inference layering and context-conditioned telemetry. Contract METEOR success alone does not authorize canonical promotion.
